title: New Words: tárgy, lakás, szoba, kulcs

sections.content: Four more nouns to round out the unit: tárgy (object), lakás (flat), szoba (room), kulcs (key). Practice them with the patterns from this unit: identity (Ez egy tárgy) and location (A kulcs a szobában van).
sections.title: Unit 5 vocabulary

items.english: The key is in the room.

sections.content: lakás takes -ban (lakásban, 'in the flat') because its last vowel, á, is a back vowel — same family as -ban and -ok you've used all unit.
